newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Mt Leyshon rejects St Barbara bid.
newsitem.headline: Mt Leyshon rejects St Barbara bid.

text.p: Mount Leyshon Gold Mines Ltd said on Monday it has recommended shareholders not accept the takeover offer from fellow gold miner St Barbara Mines Ltd.
"Your directors believe that a takeover by St Barbara does not produce a clear advantage to Mt Leyshon shareholders, given their view of the nature of St Barbara's assets," Mt Leyshon said.

St Barbara's offer of 32 of its shares for every 10 Mt Leyshon shares would have given Normandy Mining Ltd a 41.3 percent stake in the merged group, which would have annual gold output of 350,000 ounces.
Normandy owns 75 percent of Mt Leyshon.
Mt Leyshon shares closed three cents down at A$1.90 and St Barbara shares ended two cents lower at 70 cents.
